adaptations: Adapt Login's centered title and circular mark, 448px card with 24px corners, and stacked 40px fields with 14px corners to the supplied EasyUI preview and Elysian theme tokens. Leave native username/password handling, IME protection, validation, notices and session navigation with the existing login page. Omit email, remember-device, social and signup controls. The login help uses an opt-in login-themed Peek Card; retain upstream appearance and motion for system load.

Take the custom-content Peek Card from EasyUI for system-load details. Retain the 288/320px panel, measured 19.6px corners, 8px gap, 16px padding, black surface, border and shadow, 0.96 scale and signed 6px/4px travel, snappy spring entrance and 120ms exit. Use Radix for the existing click trigger, viewport collision placement, Escape and focus restoration; the portal escapes the sidebar drawer, and exiting content is inert. Preserve all live diagnostic content and honor reduced motion.

Add a CSS-only Sidebar density preset for desktop viewports from 1440px: 64px brand area, 36px mark, 40px navigation/footer rows, 20px icons and 4px row gaps. Keep upstream widths, compact desktop/mobile density, motion, and navigation behavior.
Map colors to existing semantic theme tokens and Chinese labels.

Copy the official Stepper and StepPanels. Map colors to Elysian semantic tokens, add localized active, completed and failed states with reduced-motion handling, and use the controlled Stepper and sliding detail panels for panel maintenance. Use equal-width horizontal steps with wrapping labels beneath the indicators and descriptions from 36rem of container width. Narrow containers keep readable step widths in a native horizontal scroller that follows the active stage and allows manual browsing between stage changes. Contain maintenance detail transitions within their border. Advance stages only from recorded task phases and package verification receipts.

Add an optional DataTable searchAction beside the built-in search field. The Docker image table keeps refresh next to search and pull in the existing right-hand toolbar slot instead of a row count; selection still replaces the normal toolbar.
Allow DataTable callers to hide the default toolbar row count without adding a right-hand action; used by the read-only login log table.
Preserve controlled values, disabled state, and reduced-motion support.

Copy the EasyUI Alert component and preserve its original tones, icons, colors, geometry, dismiss animation, and accessibility behavior. Use its existing tone for each message record and pass the stored message text unchanged. Keep its live role suppressed inside message history because the MessageCenter's existing live region announces only newly arrived messages.
Disable infrastructure count-up/delta classification; retain StatCard pointer and keyboard scrubber.
Preserve sampling timestamps and use host size observer fallback.
Extend StatCard with directional IO series and details bound to the same historical sample index.

Add optional fixed valueDomain, zeroBaseline and rolling timeWindowMs to StatCard. Resource percentages use 0–100 and IO series share a zero-based domain. Keep paths mounted across append/eviction, move timestamp-matched samples left over 280ms, show a single-sample marker, and bind historical selection to timestamps rather than shifting indices. Stable time-bucket sampling retains original values and endpoints; reduced motion installs complete geometry immediately.
Add controlled value, per-instance shared-layout IDs, Chinese group labeling and roving keyboard focus to PillNavigation; preserve pill morphing and reduced-motion support.

Match the circular RefreshButton geometry with a 32px NotificationBell trigger and a 14px icon. Keep the arrival shake and offset rose badge mapped to semantic theme tokens. Retain the existing message store, Radix drawer, tooltip, F8 shortcut and focus restoration. Use boolean unread state without inferring a count.
Use the existing EasyUI Button icon variant for the dashboard refresh action, preserving its tooltip, busy spinner and request deduplication.
Use PillNavigation for security header tabs while preserving the existing responsive dropdown and in-memory tab state.

Reuse LiquidToggle SVG blob and spring motion through a shared ToggleSwitch adapter for every boolean settings switch. Keep the upstream fixed 4px blob inset and width/height track API. Use a compact 48x26 track inside the shared 56x32 hit target with a resting blob of about 18px, center the SVG against the track border box, use muted neutral on/off palettes per theme, remove visible state labels, and retain controlled/disabled/busy semantics and spring-driven settling without idle intervals.

Keep the dashboard header mounted for loading, error and empty history; update existing cards and SVGs in place, pair live samples by timestamp and interpolate numeric coordinates inside the SVG clip instead of remounting paths or morphing incompatible path strings and persist live demo samples into its frontend history buffer.

Unify primary page tabs, toolbar filters and form segments through PillNavigation adapters; preserve controlled state, disabled state, repeated-selection callbacks and responsive header dropdowns. Scope long-row scrolling within each pill bar; remove the obsolete AnimatedTabs copy and measured slider hook.
Use the existing EasyUI soft neutral Badge for firewall rule totals, replacing the divided custom stat chips while preserving live counts and immediate text updates.

Copy IOSSearchBar behind the shared SearchInput adapter for every panel search surface. Keep its pill, focus state, quick-clear animation and Escape blur; add a stable accessible name, Chinese clear tooltip, composition-safe Enter, disabled clear and reduced-motion support. Map colors to semantic theme tokens and preserve the default 40px size and 220px-to-340px focus expansion. Add a 32px compact size for the firewall toolbar, with 14px desktop text and 16px mobile text. Clamp at the container width on narrow screens and omit the unbound shortcut hint.

Copy PressButton for firewall text actions, preserving upstream default size, variants, pressStrength, anisotropic compression and spring return. Resolve the upstream radius tokens locally (10px/14px) instead of inheriting the workbench tokens. The firewall table context shares the search height across navigation, text actions and circular refresh: 36px at viewport widths from 640px, otherwise 40px; retain Tooltip and loading state. Remove obsolete toolbar control overrides, reserve the search expanded width in the intrinsic probe, and wrap tabs/actions/search groups without compressing EasyUI controls. The status strip retains 4px vertical padding.

Extract global SearchInput and circular RefreshButton adapters. Migrate all search fields, including SelectDropdown and image-reference autocomplete, while retaining caller-owned filtering, debounce, composition guards, keyboard handlers, refs and input restrictions. Expose native input and clear-keyboard integration through IOSSearchBar, restore focus before caller clear cleanup, and retain controlled values. All refresh controls share EasyUI Button, Tooltip, busy disabling and reduced-motion feedback; remove local firewall/dashboard refresh copies and obsolete ExtensionSearch markup.

Unify all panel button elements behind components/Button.tsx and the copied PressButton; easyui/Button.tsx remains an API compatibility export, not a second motion implementation. Preserve loading text, icons, refs, form attributes and explicit or implicit submit types. Use the 32px compact shell with the upstream 14px radius, semantic neutral/danger/warning/success variants and local theme tokens. Retain the specialized geometry and direct children of tabs, switches, pagination, menus, drag handles and disclosures through the unstyled compound-control mode. Use native pointer/keyboard press state in the panel adapter so Motion does not synthesize pointerdown events from Enter and change Radix menu or drag semantics; preserve compression and spring return, reset on cancel/blur/disable and honor reduced motion. Compose entry/exit, bell rotation and press transitions independently. All icon and refresh wrappers share this implementation and retain their Tooltip and controlled busy state. Remove legacy action-shell classes and conflicting local geometry; preserve compact card-action spacing and zero icon padding.

Copy DataTable for all interactive business table views. Preserve official layout, sorting, filtered select-all, Shift selection, sticky headers, viewport-bounded scrolling (explicit pixel caps remain available) and cards below 640px. Lock live-preview radii locally (25.2px shell, 19.6px controls), map semantic colors and Chinese labels, and use the panel unstyled Button and SelectDropdown for compound controls. Add stable getRowId, controlled query/external filtering, active/scope lifecycle and file row interaction/wrapper hooks without mutating domain rows. Keep batch execution and reports mounted independently of toolbar transitions; reset projection on responsive topology changes and use identity-based focus/range anchors. Only expose caller-provided batch actions; omit automatic batch copying. Preserve server log search, file tree search, cursor loading, row actions and actual batch outcomes. Let a custom right toolbar replace the row tally and retain its measured height during selection. Add an optional toolbarNavigation slot outside the animated search/selection replacement; its container grid keeps search, navigation and actions in one row from 832px, moves navigation above search/actions below 832px; firewall keeps search and both actions inline below 480px, with a circular accessible plus SVG instead of the add label. Keep navigation mounted and clickable during selection, anchor compact batch/clear icon actions together 8px after the persistent navigation, with Tooltip and stable accessible names; retain the mounted batch component and its existing confirmation/report lifecycle. On narrow selected layouts reclaim the unused normal-action row, keep the selected count below navigation, and constrain only the tab scroller on very narrow screens to reserve room for the two icons; default tables retain their existing layout. SSH key and host-user tables opt into an inline action layout with shrinking search; their shared panel TableCreateButton switches its text to an accessible SVG plus icon below 416px of table width without remounting the button, and creation/refresh follow the search height. Host-user creation/refresh replace the top row tally while the demo status remains separate. Firewall rule tabs use this persistent navigation slot in one table instance so the upstream shared-layout spring and native focus survive view changes. Keep selection, sort and batch scope separate per rule kind, and use a constant visible add-action label with contextual accessibility names. Measure the desktop scroll viewport against the window/main pane and padding instead of imposing a fixed 520px cap; keep short tables natural, remeasure layout/viewport changes and preserve numeric dialog limits and mobile page scrolling. Replace the Show more footer with scroll-driven batch mounting: an observed sentinel inside the body mounts the next batch before the end is reached, using the table scroller as root on desktop and the viewport in card mode, so every filtered row stays reachable by scrolling alone while long tables keep sorting cheap. Remove unused demo/chart cells and legacy numbered pagination.

Copy GooeyMenu behind the shared GooeySelect adapter for collapsed security, container, database, logs and settings tabs, dashboard time ranges and terminal sessions. Preserve the upstream SVG Gaussian blur/metaball color matrix, measured trigger corners, 12px gap, 306px panel, 22px panel corners, 44px rows, 10px panel padding, 14px row corners, themed selection dot, rotating chevron, independent drop/grow/snap/row springs and staggered option transitions. Use the official custom-trigger API for a 32px pill matching the notification trigger with 12px label padding and a 16px chevron. Replace the official solid black/light and near-black/dark palettes with the workbench raised neutral ramp through semantic theme tokens, because the fused metaball surface cannot carry a border: the pill and panel use the raised control tone on graphite and a line-tone gray on the light canvas, the active row lifts toward the surface tone, and label, chevron and dot follow the current theme foreground, muted and accent tokens. Use the unstyled shared Button. Keep the fused pill and morphing panel in one fixed surface so clipped terminal/dashboard ancestors cannot cut off the menu; clamp horizontal placement and panel width to the viewport, flip above when needed and scroll long lists within available height. Preserve upstream listbox/active-descendant focus and controlled state; add separate domain identities/display labels, disabled-item skipping, Home/End, typeahead, Tab and focus restoration without changing values or effects. Repeated selection still invokes the caller. Dismiss hidden/disabled responsive controls, hide closed options from accessibility with aria-hidden/inert and honor reduced motion. Retire SplitSelect/SplitButton while retaining original expanded PillNavigation, responsive measurements and form SelectDropdown.

Use the shared LiquidToggle only in firewall TCP inbound rule create/edit forms; keep row actions limited to edit and delete; derive state from the unchanged scan port list so IPv4/IPv6 rows share a port setting. Show a read-only 14px semantic-success ShieldCheck beside protected port labels, with the existing Radix Tooltip on hover and keyboard focus; reuse the shared rule scan predicate and hide confirmation markers while scan state is unknown. Preserve port text and sort/search accessors across desktop rows and mobile cards. Expand required, prefilled detection-window, hit-threshold and ban-duration fields below the form toggle, with the existing integer limits and a clear shared-policy notice; hide inactive fields and preserve edited drafts on failures. Save changed settings through the existing scan config adapter using the latest port-toggle receipt, preserving session guards, readback and retry identity. Use the shared ScrollArea for the enlarged dialog body. Remove the separate scan toolbar button/dialog. Keep unsupported targets disabled with a reason, preserve write busy state, error readback and session generation protection. The panel TableCreateButton supports a contextual aria-label; firewall switches it to a circular SVG below 480px while retaining the same button and search row. Keep compact edit/delete cells and the original mobile card layout. Add an optional desktop minWidth to DataTable (default 560px, ignored in card mode). Give the nine-column firewall port table a 1200px readable minimum and explicit per-column minmax tracks, including 176px for both source and note. Use the shared table-scrollbar inside the existing sticky-header scroll viewport, keeping toolbar and footer fixed to the container width. Allow long cell tokens to wrap anywhere on desktop and mobile without changing data, accessors, sorting or selection; avoid page-level horizontal overflow.

Copy the official Sidebar source for desktop and mobile navigation. Preserve the 248px/56px width spring (420 stiffness, 36 damping, 0.8 mass), 56px header, 36px rows, 8px navigation padding, 2px row gaps, 8px item corners, 18px icons, moving hover pill, shared-layout active pill, 150ms label fade, bottom collapse action/shortcut, icon tooltips, 17rem/85vw mobile drawer, 2px overlay blur and left-swipe thresholds. Split shell/panel/drawer exports so AppShell retains its existing global-versus-chat collapse states, mutually exclusive navigation/conversation drawers and route-owned focus restoration. Retain React Router anchor semantics through renderLink and add optional per-item attributes/actions for the existing pointer and keyboard reorder implementation; keep one persistent preference list, pinned dashboard, drag cancellation, mounted links and focus. Exclude reorder handles from horizontal drawer dragging. Use non-nested Radix Dialog for focus trapping, Escape, outside dismissal and scroll lock; hide/inert exiting drawer contents while preserving official spring transitions. Scope exact upstream neutral palettes through sidebar theme tokens; adapt load, theme, follow-system and account actions to the official row/icon geometry without changing values or session/logout behavior. Reuse unstyled panel Button, Radix Tooltip portals, resilient size observation and reduced-motion fallbacks. Keep the desktop toggle mounted, close mobile navigation on crossing the desktop breakpoint and preserve editor/terminal shortcuts. Remove the old fixed-inner-width clipping/translated-toggle stylesheet and active-link border.
